causalModel.founding: The yard is built as a fixture. It holds ten kit pieces. Each piece stands on ground under 2 deg. The yard proves the settlement runtime.
causalModel.occupantsMotive: The yard has no occupants. It has no lore.
causalModel.pressures: The yard has no pressures. It is never published to the shipped build.
causalModel.siteAdvantages: The ground is empty and measured. The mean slope is 4.08 deg. Recorded water lies 60.6 m east for the berth.
causalModel.wouldChangeIf: The yard changes if a kit piece under test changes. It also changes if the runtime contract moves.

combatSpaces.why: The yard is open ground. It is kept clear for the animation tests.
